test7638.after:
def test_short_or_failed_write_is_clean_refusal(tmp_path):
    h = run(BASE + [PLAN("p", "i", 1)], journal=str(tmp_path / "j.jsonl"))
    h._journal_path = str(tmp_path)                   # a directory
    assert not h.rebind_plan_owner("a1", "p", "i", actor="op", reason="t")
    assert h._plan_owner.get("a1:p") is None          # clean refusal
    # Astra 7750 Low: a directory in place of the journal is a replaced entry
    # -> "changed" fence and unhealthy (previously reported healthy)
    st = h.journal_status()
    assert st["healthy"] is False and st["fence"]["kind"] == "changed"
test7638.interpretation: Legitimate correction: a directory is an integrity/type replacement, not a transient regular-file write error; owner remains unbound. The independent real-path directory witness agrees.

exceptions.exclusive_creation: O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL creates a new regular file or fails EEXIST on an existing FIFO/symlink/directory before peer wait or write. No helper is required for this open; verified FIFO case. Literal policy every open wording is overbroad, not a durability defect.
exceptions.parent_directory: _fsync_dir uses O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_DIRECTORY. Stable trusted ancestor symlinks intentionally allowed; Linux-only qualification.
